title: 100kW QuietSIte II 5.9L Cummins
description: This is a nice 100kW Onan QuietSite II generator powered by a 5.9L Cummins Turbo-Diesel. It is capable of generating single or three-phase power and has approximately 7,020 hours on the machine. It's mounted on a sturdy trailer with a built-in ~225-gallon fuel tank—which is currently almost full. The sound-insulated enclosure makes the machine very quiet for the power generated. The worst thing about the entire machine is faded paint.
specs: Condition: 100% ready to hook up, wire in, and make power.

title: 105kW WinPower 7.4L 454 Turbo Natural Gas
description: Formerly a firestation backup unit, this 100kW natural gas generator is powered by a GM 454-Turbo engine. It's housed in an industrial enclosure and has approximately 340 hours. The unit cranks, runs, and generates exactly as it should, providing 3-phase 208V, 347A or single-phase power. There is a rust hole on the turbo manifold, which is visible in the pictures.
specs: Condition: Cranks, Runs, stabilizes, not load tested (insufficient fuel supply at Ecru shop), rust hole in exhaust.

title: 40kW 5.7L Natural Gas
description: Formerly a firehouse power backup, this Winpower 40kW generator is in an industrial enclosure and is powered by natural gas, featuring a 5.7L GM engine. The unit has approximately 315 hours and runs and generates power exactly as it should, providing single or 3-phase power.
specs: Condition: Cranks, Runs, stabilizes, not load tested (insufficient fuel supply at Ecru shop)
